name: map

args.name: f
args.description: Function that takes an element and returns its replacement

args.name: xs
args.description: List or other supported container whose elements are transformed

description:
Apply f to each element of xs, preserving the container's structure. For a list, the result has the same length and element order.

In the type signature, a is the input element type, b is the output element type, and m is the container type. The function may change the element type.

In the example below, |x: x+1| defines a function that adds 1 to its argument.
